purpose: Assemble separate activation, completeness, and necessity obligations without execution, proof, or substitution.

required.statement: Preserve exactly three separately typed and non-substitutable claims, distinct identities, opaque payloads, traces, nine unresolved identifiers, unresolved fulfillment and identity statuses, and TLC-EA-HUIT-013-001.
Return an immutable deterministic three-obligation ActivationCNSObligationSet.

forbidden.statement: Do not execute activation, prove coverage, completeness, or necessity, substitute claims, or simulate dimension removal.
Do not alias identities, mutate inputs, resolve boundaries, or publish partial success.

deferred.statement: Activation execution, CNS proof, feature boundary, identity, types, signatures, units, order, aggregation, numerics, and oracle semantics remain unresolved.
Concrete runtime representation and resource choices remain implementation-defined.

operations.purpose: Validate and preserve the three separately typed obligation claims.

inputs.name: claims
inputs.semantic_role: exact activation, completeness, and necessity role map

constraints.statement: The three source identities and claim types are distinct; input transport order is non-semantic.
Exactly three non-substitutable typed obligations preserve identities, types, payloads, traces, and unresolved statuses.

preconditions.statement: All three exact roles, distinct identities and types, traces, reservations, and assumption are present.
No substitution, execution, proof, coverage, or dimension-removal simulation request is present.

postconditions.statement: The set contains exactly activation, completeness, and necessity obligations with distinct types and identities.
Fulfillment, boundary, identity, and all nine reservations remain unresolved.

invariants.statement: Obligation separation, source identities, claim types, payload bytes, traces, and limited status remain unchanged.
Completeness and necessity are non-substitutable and no dimension is removed or simulated.

steps: validate exact roles types identities and traces

partial_order.before: validate exact roles types identities and traces

prescription_basis: Observable obligation separation and unresolved preservation constrain publication; no activation, proof, or unique total algorithm is prescribed.

error_contract.condition: Schema-compatible public alias for authoritative source error FAIL-HUIT-013-MISSING-TRACE: a required claim, identity, trace, reservation, or assumption is missing.
Schema-compatible public alias for authoritative source error FAIL-HUIT-013-OPERATION: substitution, activation execution, coverage or CNS proof, or dimension-removal simulation is requested.
Schema-compatible public alias for authoritative source error FAIL-HUIT-013-SCIENTIFIC-INVENTION: unstated activation, completeness, necessity, or proof semantics are supplied.

implementation_modes.statement: Expose three separate typed obligations with unresolved statuses.
Do not activate, prove, substitute, or simulate dimension removal.
Internal architecture is free when observable obligations are satisfied.

global_invariants.statement: Obligation separation, type and identity, opacity, unresolved fulfillment and boundary status, immutability, and provenance cannot be weakened.
Completeness and necessity never become interchangeable and no obligation becomes fulfilled by default.

notes: Conformance is structural and does not authorize activation or proof or prescribe a language, serialization, or total internal algorithm.
